plugins.prepareCmd: python3 -c "import pathlib,re,sys; v=sys.argv[1]; p=pathlib.Path('pyproject.toml'); p.write_text(re.sub(r'^version = \".*\"', 'version = \"'+v+'\"', p.read_text(), count=1, flags=re.M)); m=pathlib.Path('plugin.yaml'); m.write_text(re.sub(r'^version: .*', 'version: '+v, m.read_text(), count=1, flags=re.M))" ${nextRelease.version}
